title: Garment
description: The source garment the user already owns. Category and fabric family come from the user or are AI-suggested and then user-confirmed; an unconfirmed suggestion is not trusted by the feasibility engine.

attribute_origin.description: Origin of category and fabric_family. ai_suggested values must be confirmed before checks treat them as known.

visible_features.description: Visible features (Stage A), e.g. button_placket, chest_pocket, curved_hem. Hidden construction is never assumed.

GarmentCategory.description: P0 supports woven_shirt recipes. jersey_tee is limited to relaxed transformations. other/unknown can only reach IDEA_ONLY or NEEDS_INPUT.

GarmentUpdate.description: User correction of garment attributes (Stage A low-confidence path). Creates no design revision on its own, but invalidates designs that depend on the changed attributes.
